filters.name: category
filters.label: Category
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM retail_lakehouse.dim_product ORDER BY 1

tiles.title: Revenue
tiles.sql: SELECT round(sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales f JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id WHERE f.order_date BETWEEN :period_from AND :period_to AND p.category = coalesce(:category, p.category)

tiles.title: Orders
tiles.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS orders FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales f JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id WHERE f.order_date BETWEEN :period_from AND :period_to AND p.category = coalesce(:category, p.category)

tiles.title: Customers
tiles.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.customer_id) AS customers FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales f JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id WHERE f.order_date BETWEEN :period_from AND :period_to AND p.category = coalesce(:category, p.category)

tiles.title: Average order value
tiles.sql: SELECT round(sum(f.net_amount) / count(DISTINCT f.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales f JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id WHERE f.order_date BETWEEN :period_from AND :period_to AND p.category = coalesce(:category, p.category)

tiles.title: Revenue by month
tiles.sql: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', f.order_date), '%Y-%m') AS month, round(sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS revenue, round(sum(f.profit), 2) AS profit FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales f JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id WHERE f.order_date BETWEEN :period_from AND :period_to AND p.category = coalesce(:category, p.category) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

tiles.title: Revenue by category
tiles.sql: SELECT p.category, round(sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS revenue, round(sum(f.profit), 2) AS profit FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales f JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id WHERE f.order_date BETWEEN :period_from AND :period_to GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

tiles.title: Channel mix
tiles.sql: SELECT f.channel, round(sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales f JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id WHERE f.order_date BETWEEN :period_from AND :period_to AND p.category = coalesce(:category, p.category) GROUP BY f.channel ORDER BY revenue DESC

tiles.title: Top 10 products
tiles.sql: SELECT p.product_name, p.category, sum(f.quantity) AS units, round(sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS revenue, round(100.0 * sum(f.profit) / sum(f.net_amount), 1) AS margin_pct FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales f JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id WHERE f.order_date BETWEEN :period_from AND :period_to AND p.category = coalesce(:category, p.category) GROUP BY p.product_name, p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

tiles.title: Top 10 stores
tiles.sql: SELECT s.store_name, round(sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales f JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id WHERE f.order_date BETWEEN :period_from AND :period_to AND p.category = coalesce(:category, p.category) GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

tiles.title: Revenue by region and weekday
tiles.sql: SELECT s.region, d.day_name AS weekday, round(sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales f JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.order_date BETWEEN :period_from AND :period_to AND p.category = coalesce(:category, p.category) GROUP BY s.region, d.day_name, d.day_of_week ORDER BY s.region, d.day_of_week
